content: For all the interest in adversarial computer vision, these attacks are rarely encountered outside of academic research. However, adversarial misspellings constitute a longstanding real-world problem. Spammers continually bombard email servers, subtly misspelling words in efforts to evade spam detection while preserving the emails' intended meaning BIBREF1 , BIBREF2 . As another example, programmatic censorship on the Internet has spurred communities to adopt similar methods to communicate surreptitiously BIBREF3 .
